allocation_policy: An xq.<profile>: namespace is allocated when the corresponding official Crosscue Event Model profile is published. Unlisted xq.*: prefixes are not official profile namespaces.
third_party_guidance: Third-party semantic identifiers should use a non-xq qualified namespace they control, for example org.example:term. Implementations claiming Crosscue vocabulary conformance must not assign private or conflicting meanings to registered xq: or allocated xq.<profile>: terms.
